description: This file defines the TaxClass controller class for the OpenCart admin module, responsible for managing tax class tasks such as listing, retrieving info, and clearing related data.

classes.name: TaxClass
classes.description: Controller class for managing tax class related tasks in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of tax class tasks and adds them to the task model.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Generates and saves detailed information about a specific tax class as a JSON file.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes generated JSON files related to tax classes.
